title: C. World of Darkraft: Battle for Azathoth

legend: Roma is playing a new expansion for his favorite game World of Darkraft. He made a new character and is going for his first grind.

Roma has a choice to buy exactly one of n$$$n$$$ different weapons and exactly one of m$$$m$$$ different armor sets. Weapon i$$$i$$$ has attack modifier ai$$$a_i$$$ and is worth cai$$$ca_i$$$ coins, and armor set j$$$j$$$ has defense modifier bj$$$b_j$$$ and is worth cbj$$$cb_j$$$ coins.

After choosing his equipment Roma can proceed to defeat some monsters. There are p$$$p$$$ monsters he can try to defeat. Monster k$$$k$$$ has defense xk$$$x_k$$$, attack yk$$$y_k$$$ and possesses zk$$$z_k$$$ coins. Roma can defeat a monster if his weapon's attack modifier is larger than the monster's defense, and his armor set's defense modifier is larger than the monster's attack. That is, a monster k$$$k$$$ can be defeated with a weapon i$$$i$$$ and an armor set j$$$j$$$ if ai>xk$$$a_i  \gt  x_k$$$ and bj>yk$$$b_j  \gt  y_k$$$. After defeating the monster, Roma takes all the coins from them. During the grind, Roma can defeat as many monsters as he likes. Monsters do not respawn, thus each monster can be defeated at most one.

Thanks to Roma's excessive donations, we can assume that he has an infinite amount of in-game currency and can afford any of the weapons and armor sets. Still, he wants to maximize the profit of the grind. The profit is defined as the total coins obtained from all defeated monsters minus the cost of his equipment. Note that Roma must purchase a weapon and an armor set even if he can not cover their cost with obtained coins.
Help Roma find the maximum profit of the grind.
input: The first line contains three integers n$$$n$$$, m$$$m$$$, and p$$$p$$$ (1≤n,m,p≤2⋅105$$$1 \leq n, m, p \leq 2 \cdot 10^5$$$) — the number of available weapons, armor sets and monsters respectively.

The following n$$$n$$$ lines describe available weapons. The i$$$i$$$-th of these lines contains two integers ai$$$a_i$$$ and cai$$$ca_i$$$ (1≤ai≤106$$$1 \leq a_i \leq 10^6$$$, 1≤cai≤109$$$1 \leq ca_i \leq 10^9$$$) — the attack modifier and the cost of the weapon i$$$i$$$.

The following m$$$m$$$ lines describe available armor sets. The j$$$j$$$-th of these lines contains two integers bj$$$b_j$$$ and cbj$$$cb_j$$$ (1≤bj≤106$$$1 \leq b_j \leq 10^6$$$, 1≤cbj≤109$$$1 \leq cb_j \leq 10^9$$$) — the defense modifier and the cost of the armor set j$$$j$$$.

The following p$$$p$$$ lines describe monsters. The k$$$k$$$-th of these lines contains three integers xk,yk,zk$$$x_k, y_k, z_k$$$ (1≤xk,yk≤106$$$1 \leq x_k, y_k \leq 10^6$$$, 1≤zk≤103$$$1 \leq z_k \leq 10^3$$$) — defense, attack and the number of coins of the monster k$$$k$$$.
output: Print a single integer — the maximum profit of the grind.

legend.ai: Roma 正在游玩他最喜欢的游戏《World of Darkraft》的一个新扩展包。他创建了一个新角色，准备进行第一次刷怪。
Roma 可以选择购买恰好一把 n$$$n$$$ 种不同武器中的武器，以及恰好一套 m$$$m$$$ 种不同护甲中的护甲。第 i$$$i$$$ 把武器具有攻击修正值 ai$$$a_i$$$，价值为 cai$$$ca_i$$$ 枚硬币；第 j$$$j$$$ 套护甲具有防御修正值 bj$$$b_j$$$，价值为 cbj$$$cb_j$$$ 枚硬币。

选择装备后，Roma 可以继续击败一些怪物。他可以尝试击败的怪物共有 p$$$p$$$ 只。第 k$$$k$$$ 只怪物具有防御力 xk$$$x_k$$$、攻击力 yk$$$y_k$$$，并持有 zk$$$z_k$$$ 枚硬币。当他的武器攻击修正值大于怪物的防御力，且护甲防御修正值大于怪物的攻击力时，Roma 就可以击败该怪物。也就是说，使用第 i$$$i$$$ 把武器和第 j$$$j$$$ 套护甲时，如果 ai>xk$$$a_i  \gt  x_k$$$ 且 bj>yk$$$b_j  \gt  y_k$$$，就可以击败第 k$$$k$$$ 只怪物。击败怪物后，Roma 会拿走它持有的全部硬币。在刷怪过程中，Roma 可以随意击败任意数量的怪物。怪物不会重生，因此每只怪物最多只能被击败一次。
由于 Roma 进行了大量捐赠，我们可以认为他拥有无限量的游戏货币，可以负担得起任何武器和护甲。然而，他仍然希望最大化刷怪的收益。收益定义为击败所有怪物获得的硬币总数减去装备的花费。注意，即使 Roma 无法用获得的硬币支付装备费用，他也必须购买一把武器和一套护甲。
请帮助 Roma 求出刷怪所能获得的最大收益。

input.ai: 第一行包含三个整数 n$$$n$$$、m$$$m$$$ 和 p$$$p$$$(1≤n,m,p≤2⋅105$$$1 \leq n, m, p \leq 2 \cdot 10^5$$$)，分别表示可用武器、护甲和怪物的数量。
接下来的 n$$$n$$$ 行描述可用的武器。其中第 i$$$i$$$ 行包含两个整数 ai$$$a_i$$$ 和 cai$$$ca_i$$$(1≤ai≤106$$$1 \leq a_i \leq 10^6$$$，1≤cai≤109$$$1 \leq ca_i \leq 10^9$$$)——武器 i$$$i$$$ 的攻击修正值和花费。
接下来的 m$$$m$$$ 行描述可用的护甲套装。其中第 j$$$j$$$ 行包含两个整数 bj$$$b_j$$$ 和 cbj$$$cb_j$$$(1≤bj≤106$$$1 \leq b_j \leq 10^6$$$，1≤cbj≤109$$$1 \leq cb_j \leq 10^9$$$)——护甲套装 j$$$j$$$ 的防御修正值和花费。
接下来的 p$$$p$$$ 行描述怪物。其中第 k$$$k$$$ 行包含三个整数 xk,yk,zk$$$x_k, y_k, z_k$$$(1≤xk,yk≤106$$$1 \leq x_k, y_k \leq 10^6$$$，1≤zk≤103$$$1 \leq z_k \leq 10^3$$$)——怪物 k$$$k$$$ 的防御力、攻击力和金币数量。

output.ai: 输出一个整数——刷怪所能获得的最大收益。
